question.prompt: In \(\triangle ABC\) and \(\triangle DEF\), \(AB=DE\), \(\angle B=\angle E\), and \(BC=EF\). Which criterion establishes that they are congruent?

solutions.explanation: \(\angle B\) is the included angle between \(AB\) and \(BC\), and \(\angle E\) is the included angle between \(DE\) and \(EF\). Two sides and their included angle are respectively equal, so the criterion is SAS.
solutions.title: Identify the included angles
